summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K with a press release updating progress on its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. During the week of 24–28 August 2026, ING repurchased 1,075,000 shares at an average price of €30.17 for €32.44 million. Cumulatively, 23,570,805 shares have been bought back at an average price of €27.57 for €649.84 million, representing approximately 64.98% of the programme's maximum value. The programme aims to reduce share capital; watch for weekly pace updates and completion of the remaining ~35%.
